templates.title: AI Basics Explainer
templates.use_case: Teach one beginner AI concept in 5 slides.
templates.thai_headline_stub: เข้าใจ AI ใน 5 สไลด์
templates.prompt: Design a clean editorial AI Academy carousel with warm ivory background, deep ink navy headline, cool slate body text, clean cyan diagram accents, warm coral emphasis marks, and muted gold slide numbers. Use generous margins, magazine-like hierarchy, clear Thai typography, simple line diagrams, and calm educational pacing. Leave editable text zones for Thai-first content.
layout_notes: Slide 1: strong headline and simple visual metaphor
Slides 2-4: one idea per slide with diagram or checklist
Slide 5: recap and next learning action
typography_notes: Thai headline must be large and readable
Body text should use short lines

templates.title: AI Workflow Tutorial
templates.use_case: Explain a practical AI workflow for operators.
templates.thai_headline_stub: Workflow ที่ทำซ้ำได้
templates.prompt: Create a clean editorial tutorial carousel for an AI workflow. Use warm ivory canvas, deep ink navy titles, cool slate captions, clean cyan arrows, warm coral callouts, and muted gold step markers. Present trigger, input, processing, review, and output as a calm process map. Keep hierarchy readable on mobile and reserve safe areas for Thai copy.
typography_notes: Use clear contrast between headline and body

templates.title: Second Brain Lesson
templates.use_case: Turn research input into structured learning cards.
templates.thai_headline_stub: เปลี่ยนไฟล์ให้เป็นสมองที่ถามตอบได้
templates.english_headline_stub: Turn Files Into a Questionable Brain
templates.prompt: Design a calm education carousel about AI second brain setup. Use warm ivory background, deep ink navy headings, cool slate knowledge cards, clean cyan connector lines, warm coral highlights for warnings, and muted gold labels for modules. Show source, summary, card, SOP, and action as a clear editorial system diagram.
typography_notes: Thai text must fit inside cards

templates.title: Agent Safety Gate
templates.use_case: Teach approval gates and safe AI agent operations.
templates.thai_headline_stub: Agent ที่ปลอดภัยต้องมี Gate
templates.prompt: Create an editorial AI Academy carousel explaining safe agent approval gates. Use warm ivory pages, deep ink navy section titles, cool slate policy cards, clean cyan routing lines, warm coral warning labels, and muted gold level markers. Show read-only, low-risk write, public-facing, and sensitive actions as a simple tier ladder.
typography_notes: Use consistent Thai labels for each tier

templates.title: Business Automation Offer
templates.use_case: Explain a business automation offer without hype.
templates.thai_headline_stub: ระบบงานที่เห็นภาพก่อนลงมือทำ
templates.prompt: Design a professional AI Academy carousel for business automation planning. Use warm ivory base, deep ink navy headlines, cool slate workflow panels, clean cyan connection lines, warm coral risk notes, and muted gold package markers.
